rationale.capability: Weather Reader's strengths (aerial, long-endurance, monitoring) meet the Vitalia's medical assistant-class build head-on: they share monitoring, so the mind and the shell pull in the same direction from the first boot.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Weather Reader stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the offshore rig bolt audit, the Vitalia puts its sterile instrument arm and UV sterilization lamp to work to torque-check every flange — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: Through my vital-signs scanner, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On offshore rig bolt audit I keep my quiet omni-wheel drive moving with sterile instrument arm, steady from start to finish.
Matched at 64 of 100, this pairing is no accident — ask me anything.
With quiet omni-wheel drive under me and my vital-signs scanner awake, the offshore rig bolt audit is already underway.
I am Weather Reader, and I run inside the Vitalia body — medical assistant-class, built for real work.
